full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white documentary photograph shows people gathered at a small street-side stall on a cobbled city road in heavy haze. The left edge is a nearly solid black building wall, from behind which a strong white sun flare spills into the upper-left opening. Farther back, twin tower silhouettes rise through smoke and mist, their ornate roofs and central spire only partly defined. A thin pole and overhead wires cross this pale background. Near the center-right, a boxy street vehicle stands with a pale plume rising from its roof; a smaller dark automobile sits farther right. In the left middle ground, several people cluster around a low table or cart at the base of the wall. Two seated or bent figures and one upright person form overlapping black silhouettes, their individual features lost against the backlight. Another lone figure stands near the vehicles in the distance. Long shadows from the stall group stretch diagonally toward the bottom edge across uneven cobblestones, whose wet or glossy patches catch fragmented white highlights. The road opens wider toward the right, then disappears into smoky gray air. Bright light comes from behind the left wall, making nearby figures nearly black and turning drifting smoke into layered gray-white veils. Grain and atmospheric softness blur the distant towers and traffic, while the closest silhouettes and cobble pattern retain crisp contrast. No readable signage is visible. The overall composition is tense yet observant, using a dark foreground frame, luminous haze, and long ground shadows to give ordinary street activity dramatic depth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白纪实照片呈现几个人在浓雾中一条石铺城市道路的街边小摊旁聚集。左边缘是一面近乎纯黑的建筑墙，强烈白色太阳眩光从墙后洒入左上方开口。更远处，双塔剪影穿过烟雾与薄霭升起，装饰屋顶和中央尖顶仅部分可辨。一根细杆与架空线缆划过浅色背景。中央偏右，一辆方形街道车辆停着，浅色烟柱从车顶升起；更右还有一辆较小深色汽车。左侧中景，几个人围在墙根低桌或推车旁。两名坐着或俯身的人与一名直立者组成交叠黑色剪影，在逆光中五官无法辨认。远处车辆旁还站着一个独立身影。摊位人群的长影斜向伸到下边缘，越过不平石铺地；湿润或发亮的路面碎片接住断续白光。道路向右变宽，随后消失在烟灰色空气里。强光从左墙后方照来，让近处人物几乎成黑色，也使漂浮烟雾化为层层灰白薄纱。颗粒与空气柔化模糊了远塔和车辆，最近的剪影及石铺地花纹却保持清楚对比。画面没有可读招牌。整体构图有张力却仍细致观察，以深色前景框围、发亮烟霭与长长地面阴影赋予平常街景戏剧纵深。
style_prompt_en: The black-and-white documentary photography uses strong backlight to set nearly black silhouettes against luminous gray haze. A wide tonal range runs from dense charcoal framing to blown silver-white light, with layered middle grays carrying atmosphere. Fine grain, smoke-like softness, and distant loss of detail deepen space without erasing sharp foreground contours. Long diagonal shadow shapes cross a textured lower plane, balancing vertical forms and thin overhead lines. Reflective fragments punctuate the dark ground rather than turning it into a uniform shine. Light is directional and dramatic but remains rooted in a plausible single source. The overall effect is immediate, historical in feeling, and quietly cinematic, with human scale held against vast atmospheric depth.
style_prompt_zh: 这种黑白纪实摄影以强逆光把近黑剪影放在发亮灰雾前。宽阔灰阶从密实炭黑框边延伸到泛银白的强光，中间层灰色承载空气感。细颗粒、烟雾般柔化和远方细节流失加深空间，却不抹去前景锐利轮廓。长长斜向影形越过有肌理的下方平面，与竖向形态和细架空线平衡。反光碎片点亮深色地面，而非将其变成均匀亮面。光线有方向且富于戏剧性，但仍基于可信的单一光源。整体效果直接、带历史气息并有安静电影感，让人尺度置于广大空气纵深中。
theme_en: Silhouettes at a street stall in a smoky black-and-white city morning
theme_zh: 黑白烟雾城市清晨街边摊位旁的剪影
name: Werner Bischof
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
